checks.text:
The duty board, in chalk. POWER OFF 4.50. DRIVE COG SHEARED. F3 BLOWN.
At the bottom, underlined twice: HAL HAS KEY.

The key switch for the drive. It's empty.
No key, no gondola.
His coffee went over. A photo of a girl with a fish, propped against the glass.

Gauze, soaked through. He dressed something in a hurry.
A bite, by the look of the first aid box. Everything in it is gone.
Fuse F3 is burnt black. The wall above it is sooty.
The handset is hanging off the hook. The line's dead.

ARKLAY SKYWAY. See the valley the way the eagles do.
Someone has scratched out the family's eyes.
A handprint in blood on the door frame. It's still tacky.

entry: The heater's still on. He can't have gone long.
notes: high over the door: the desk under the holed window, the tipped chair, the duty board
high in the north-west corner: the fuse box, the phone, the poster, the blood to the door
